limitations: Reused development seasons; not an independent holdout.
Final historical calendars; future origins use an unverified 90-minute proxy deadline.
23 missing future labels per arm excluded rather than zero-filled.
Role and full-match CS ablations rejected; v1 remains selected candidate.
Shared draws have independent minutes, full-match CS and conditional-mean residuals; not verified calibrated tails.
Recourse and rival value verified synthetically; no real ex-ante information nodes or authenticated Top100 history.
